antithesis: Prolonged exposure at 635nm may decrease mitochondrial biogenesis and generate oxidative stress in beta_cell if irradiance exceeds optimal threshold. Paper (2025) notes dose-dependent tissue response.
synthesis: Apply Dual-phase: Hsp70 activation (220 THz, 10^-12s) + CcO pulse (370 THz, 10^-15s, 30% amp) targeting NO_synthase in beta_cell. Study reference: 2025 peer-reviewed paper shows NO modulation at 635nm. Dual-phase protocol minimizes off-target thermal effects while maximizing mitochondrial complex_III_cytochrome_bc1 activation.
